mapper.select: SELECT * FROM refund_record WHERE (status=0 AND next_execute_time <= #{now}) OR (status=1 AND lease_expire_time <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_execute_time LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_record SET status=1,lease_owner=#{owner},lease_expire_time=#{until} WHERE id=#{id} AND (status=0 OR (status=1 AND lease_expire_time <= #{now}))
UPDATE refund_record SET status=2,provider_refund_no=#{providerRefundNo},lease_owner=NULL,lease_expire_time=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status=1 AND lease_owner=#{owner}

UPDATE refund_record SET status=0,retry_count=retry_count+1,next_execute_time=#{next},failure_reason=#{error},lease_owner=NULL,lease_expire_time=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status=1 AND lease_owner=#{owner}
UPDATE refund_record SET status=3,failure_reason=#{error},lease_owner=NULL,lease_expire_time=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status=1 AND lease_owner=#{owner}
